verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat runs inside the GitLab UI and has access to the project's issues, merge requests, commits, and CI/CD pipelines. It searches that data conversationally and can give advice, propose solutions, and implement them. Agents also review code and remediate vulnerabilities directly in the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights are useful, and documentation of proactive or analytics-style insight features beyond chat and agent suggestions.
